versions.changelog:
Initial release of citation-chasing-mapping.

- Enables mapping of citation networks to trace research evolution and identify influential papers.
- Supports discovery of related work through reference and co-citation analysis.
- Assists with systematic reviews, bibliometric analysis, and research planning.
- Provides tools for research lineage mapping, collaboration identification, and visualizing citation networks.
- Includes Python API and command line usage with export and visualization features.
